group: Collection Vault 3: Titles, Subtitles & Pen Names
title: Table 3A: 3A: Borrowed Literary Titles (Work → Source Poem/Play/Bible)
subtitle: Covers the 4 classic titular traps in UGC NET: Where did a novel borrow its title from? What is the exact subtitle of a work? What was an author's pseudonym? Which chronicle or novella did Shakespeare adapt?
